t: This is St Paul's, a Grade II* listed Anglican church on Queen Caroline Street in Hammersmith. Two architects are linked to it. John Pollard Seddon, who worked largely on churches, and Hugh Roumieu Gough, who practised mainly in the London area, are both credited with designing it. Sir Nicholas Crispe is buried here. He was a Royalist and a wealthy merchant, a customs farmer and a Member of Parliament, who was made a baronet in 1665. He also pioneered the West African slave trade in the 1630s.
